requirements.text: LOOP CONTINUITY - the build loop must be kept running. When a run stops, the orchestrator diagnoses the recorded stop reason from primary runtime evidence and restores the loop rather than leaving it down; a stopped loop is reported with its reason, never silently left parked.
requirements.required_harness: supervisor status/log evidence showing a live run after each restore
requirements.required_evidence: supervisor run log + status at the restore seam
requirements.status_reason: captured; actuation recorded in the same seam

requirements.text: FABLE-EXHAUSTION HARD STOP MET -> OPUS FALLBACK ACTUATION AUTHORIZED. The 'fable_exhaustion_turnover_recorded' REFUSED-unsafe stop (exit 11) together with the runtime's own usage-limit fallback of the orchestrator session IS the genuine hard-stop last-resort condition D-058-R004 reserves the opus chain for. The worker may therefore be pinned to the already-allowlisted, owner-approved 'claude-opus-4-8' (immutable config.toml allowed_models + the armed quota_exhausted fallback chain) so the loop keeps running, following the owner's own 2026-08-09 / 2026-09-07 manual recovery precedent (D-036-R002). The actuation is recorded as a deviation with its evidence and revert condition in the model_selection.toml provenance block; no allowlist is widened and no new model is introduced.
requirements.required_harness: model_selection.toml diff carrying the D-060 citation, the frozen evidence, and the revert condition; a live run on the fallback model
requirements.required_evidence: model_selection.toml + supervisor run log at the relaunch seam
requirements.status_reason: captured; actuation recorded in the same seam

requirements.text: REVERT ON FABLE RETURN - the pin returns to 'claude-fable-5' as soon as Fable is available again (normally the weekly reset, D-036-R001/D-055), evidenced by a launch probe or a session observed running Fable; the fallback chain is restored to ["claude-opus-4-8"] at that revert. The opus pin is temporary by construction and must not outlive the exhaustion.
requirements.required_harness: revert commit restoring model='claude-fable-5' with availability evidence
requirements.status_reason: captured; actuation recorded in the same seam

requirements.text: NO QUALITY OR SCOPE RELAXATION - keeping the loop alive changes the worker model only. Unchanged and non-waivable: independent review (producer != reviewer), all G0-G7 gates, dependency policy SectionG, sequential integration, sole orchestrator ledger/git/gh authority, every active owner hold (PR #241 never merged, expansion hold, G6, Tier D / Section 20), and the D-059-R008 step-1 priority on dependable answers. Loop continuity never becomes a reason to skip or soften any of these.
requirements.required_harness: gates/holds unchanged across the restore seam
requirements.status_reason: captured; actuation recorded in the same seam

requirements.text: PRIMARY-EVIDENCE DISCIPLINE FOR MODEL FACTS - model availability/exhaustion claims come only from primary runtime records (the supervisor's recorded stop reason and the runtime's own model-switch/usage-limit log), never from a model's self-report or an inference from behavior; the frozen evidence is quoted in the capture.
requirements.required_harness: quoted primary records in the directive source
requirements.status_reason: captured; actuation recorded in the same seam
